title: An invoice does not match the quotation
summary: A verification sequence for mismatched amounts, quantities, currencies or payment terms before any financial record is treated as final.
contentNotice: Demonstration playbook for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy and must be reviewed before operational use.
scenario: Use this when an invoice differs from the approved quotation, purchase understanding or documented commercial terms.
immediateAction: Pause approval of the disputed amount; do not silently edit the supplier document or reinterpret the difference.
Compare the invoice against the latest approved quotation and any documented revision.
Identify each discrepancy explicitly: amount, quantity, currency, tax, freight, payment term or line item.

whoToInform.when: As soon as the mismatch is confirmed.
Before approving a material exception or new commercial term.

escalationConditions: The supplier requests payment before correcting or explaining the discrepancy.
The difference changes the approved budget or commitment.
The mismatch suggests duplicate billing, an undocumented scope change or a recurring documentation problem.

templatesResources.label: Discrepancy note
templatesResources.text: List the quoted value, invoiced value, difference and source document for each mismatched line.
